a: TTFB is time to first byte from the server.
FCP is First Contentful Paint — first text/image rendered.
TTI estimates when the page becomes reliably interactive.
INP (Interaction to Next Paint) measures responsiveness to user input.
TBT sums long tasks that block the main thread between FCP and TTI.
React.lazy and dynamic import() split bundles by route/component.
preconnect warms connections; preload fetches critical assets early.
font-display: swap reduces invisible text during font load.
Hydration attaches JS to server HTML; large trees increase delay.
Lighthouse CI tracks performance scores on every pull request.
